arguments.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE o AS (
  SELECT *, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY offer_id) AS i
  FROM input
  WHERE CAST(arrival_date AS DATE) <= DATE '2026-09-25' AND max_batches > 0
),
n AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS k FROM o),
c(i, cost, margin, boxes, pick) AS (
  SELECT 0, 0.0, 0.0, 0, CAST('' AS VARCHAR)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT c.i + 1,
         c.cost + b.n * o.cost_yuan,
         c.margin + b.n * o.margin_yuan,
         c.boxes + b.n * o.boxes,
         c.pick || CASE WHEN b.n > 0 THEN o.offer_id || 'x' || b.n || ' ' ELSE '' END
  FROM c
  JOIN o ON o.i = c.i + 1
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(0, o.max_batches) AS b(n)
  WHERE c.i < (SELECT k FROM n)
)
SELECT pick AS plan, cost AS cost_yuan, margin AS margin_yuan, boxes
FROM c
WHERE i = (SELECT k FROM n) AND cost <= 2250 AND boxes <= 18
ORDER BY margin DESC, cost ASC
LIMIT 20;
